data.desc: Saentra Forge is the business name of Genenta Science S.p.A. (Nasdaq: SAEN), a next-generation strategic industrial consolidator focused on acquiring majority or full ownership of companies operating in security-regulated sectors, with activities spanning aerospace, defense and national security - including physical AI, robotics, autonomous systems, advanced sensors and cybersecurity - as well as biotechnology and biosecurity. The Company seeks to acquire and retain profitable businesses operating in sectors covered by Italy's Golden Power legislation and integrate them into a transparent, Nasdaq-listed platform. Its portfolio includes A.T.C. S.r.l., a wholly owned subsidiary, and Sophia High Tech S.r.l., in which the Company holds a strategic investment with a contractual path to majority ownership through existing options.
